The '''J-14 composite armor''' was an improved type of composite [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Hull/Legends|armor]] produced by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for use in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
